english.title: Leave a taxi on a taxi feeder park on Gatwick Airport when not willing to be dispatched to an authorised standing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the permission of Gatwick Airport Limited, left a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a taxi feeder park on Gatwick Airport - London, when not willing to be dispatched immediately to an authorised standing
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 9(6) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
